headline: Operations Leader
profile: Operations leader with 15 years' experience running teams, budgets and logistics behind large-scale live events, from theatre and TV studio builds to heading a six-person department at BLAST. Led team management, budgeting and process improvement across 60+ flagship events and 300+ qualifiers in 13 countries, with €12m+ in budgets, 2,000+ freelancers and vendors managed, and performance tracked through the department's own operational tools. Experienced in restructuring teams, stakeholder management and building clearer operational procedures and documentation from scratch. Hands-on across procurement, supplier and vendor management, invoicing and budget control. Looking to bring that operational leadership and process discipline to a growing consumer brand.

jobs.title: Head of Esports Operations
bullets: Led a six-person department running operations across every BLAST ecosystem, including CS2, Dota 2, Brawl Stars, Fortnite, Rocket League and Rainbow Six
Rebuilt how the department works, with clearer ownership, accountability and proper documentation
Designed and built the department's own tools for operational tracking, freelancer calendars, bookings and contracting, and budgets and deadlines
Wrote the business case for a departmental OPEX budget covering equipment renewal, software and cross-event costs
Costed and pitched new work with the product and commercial teams
Brought Team Operations into the department, so all player management and support sat with one team
Set technical requirements for commercial partnerships

Approved equipment and staffing invoices, and decided when to hire, buy or repair kit
Booked and managed operations freelancers for internal, external and online productions
Main tournament-level contact for FACEIT, ESIC and BLAST Premier teams

Designated Safeguarding Lead and first aider at live events

jobs.title: Broadcast Freelancer
